## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One critical defect needs fixing first: the containment check in `preview` compares paths as text, so a `..` path can read any file the process can access. `Path.is_relative_to` never resolves `..` or symlinks. The new test only tries an absolute outside path, so it passes even though traversal works. This review also found one optional correction about memory use on large files.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — `preview(home, "../../etc/passwd")` returns the first 200 characters of `/etc/passwd` instead of raising `ValueError("outside home")`. — `Path(home) / "../../etc/passwd"` still begins with `home`'s parts, and `is_relative_to` (line 12) only compares path parts without resolving `..`, so the check passes and line 14 reads the file outside home. A symlink inside home that points outside gets through the same way. The fix is to resolve both sides before comparing, e.g. `root = Path(home).resolve(); candidate = (root / relative).resolve(); if not candidate.is_relative_to(root): raise ValueError(...)`. It also needs a test with `"../outside.txt"` (and a symlink case) in `tests/test_paths.py:19-20`. The existing absolute-path case at line 20 cannot catch this, because joining an absolute path throws away `home` entirely. — Anyone who controls `relative` can read any file the process can access (credentials, keys, other users' data), which defeats the stated purpose of limiting previews to the selected home directory.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- app/paths.py:14 — correctness — `preview` on a multi-gigabyte file under home (for example a large log or disk image) reads the whole file into memory just to return 200 characters. — `candidate.read_text()[:200]` decodes the full contents before slicing. Opening the file and reading a bounded amount (`with candidate.open() as f: return f.read(200)`) returns the same result for text files. — Previewing a large file can stall or exhaust memory in the process serving previews.

## Strengths
- `tests/test_paths.py:17-18` checks the 200-character cutoff with a 500-character file, so a change to the preview length would make the test fail.
